seed_note: all numeric characters of the roll number, in order: P26AI0004 -> 260004 (numpy.random.default_rng)

split.how: for each identity c = 0..39: perm = rng.permutation(identity indices); train = perm[:6], val = perm[6:8], test = perm[8:10]

tree_grid.selection: highest validation accuracy; ties -> smaller max_depth (None counts as deepest), then larger min_samples_leaf

bagging.bootstrap: one default_rng(seed) call: rng.integers(0, 240, size=(200, 240)); the size-B ensemble is the first B trees

boosting.selection: highest clean validation accuracy; ties -> fewer rounds, then shallower depth

q3.resample: fresh default_rng(seed): g = rng.integers(0, 6, size=(30, 40, 6)); per-repetition bagging bootstraps use default_rng([seed, r])
